text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, I was looking up all sorts of Umart of Windy-chan...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy cool",
"Windy evil"...
I searched for everything I could think of...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it, it was the middle of the night...
Lately, it's been happening a lot...
Shinko Windy is so engrossed in vanity searching herself that she keeps staying up late...
